254    /**
255     * @param string|null $gender 'male', 'female' or null for any
256     *
257     * @example 'Doe'
258     *
259     * @return string
260     */
261    public function lastName($gender = null)
262    {
263        if ($gender === static::GENDER_MALE) {
264            return static::lastNameMale();
265        }
266
267        if ($gender === static::GENDER_FEMALE) {
268            return static::lastNameFemale();
269        }
270
271        return $this->generator->parse(static::randomElement(static::$lastNameFormat));
272    }

322    /**
323     * National Personal Identity number (asmens kodas)
324     *
325     * @see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_identification_number#Lithuania
326     * @see https://lt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asmens_kodas
327     *
328     * @param string $gender       [male|female]
329     * @param string $randomNumber three integers
330     *
331     * @return string on format XXXXXXXXXXX
332     */
333    public function personalIdentityNumber($gender = 'male', ?\DateTime $birthdate = null, $randomNumber = '')
334    {
335        if (!$birthdate) {
336            $birthdate = \Faker\Provider\DateTime::dateTimeThisCentury();
337        }
338
339        $genderNumber = ($gender == 'male') ? 1 : 0;
340        $firstNumber = (int) floor($birthdate->format('Y') / 100) * 2 - 34 - $genderNumber;
341
342        $datePart = $birthdate->format('ymd');
343        $randomDigits = (string) (!$randomNumber || strlen($randomNumber) < 3) ? static::numerify('###') : substr($randomNumber, 0, 3);
344        $partOfPerosnalCode = $firstNumber . $datePart . $randomDigits;
345
346        $sum = self::calculateSum($partOfPerosnalCode, 1);
347        $liekana = $sum % 11;
348
349        if ($liekana !== 10) {
350            $lastNumber = $liekana;
351
352            return $firstNumber . $datePart . $randomDigits . $lastNumber;
353        }
354
355        $sum = self::calculateSum($partOfPerosnalCode, 2);
356        $liekana = $sum % 11;
357
358        $lastNumber = ($liekana !== 10) ? $liekana : 0;
359
360        return $firstNumber . $datePart . $randomDigits . $lastNumber;
361    }
362
363    /**
364     * Calculate the sum of personal code
365     *
366     * @see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_identification_number#Lithuania
367     * @see https://lt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asmens_kodas
368     *
369     * @param string $numbers
370     * @param int    $time    [1|2]
371     *
372     * @return int
373     */
374    private static function calculateSum($numbers, $time = 1)
375    {
376        if ($time == 1) {
377            $multipliers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 1];
378        } else {
379            $multipliers = [3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 1, 2, 3];
380        }
381
382        $sum = 0;
383
384        for ($i = 1; $i <= 10; ++$i) {
385            $sum += ((int) $numbers[$i - 1]) * $multipliers[$i - 1];
386        }
387
388        return (int) $sum;
389    }
